ns2:course.label: Graphic Design Inquiry
ns2:course.description: A series of topical studios that touch upon the myriad practices of graphic design. Students produce and analyze form and content according to each individual topic. Media engagement varies across sections. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. May be repeated up to 8 hours. Prerequisite: ARTD 251.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. May be repeated up to 8 hours. Prerequisite: ARTD 251.
